title: Sample a known face law approximately with exact output support
statement: Compute an exact local mean witness and select its face atom y. Choose T with ideal tilted off-face mass<=delta/4; call the existing unconditional full-law DDB1 sampler at the ordinary tilted activities with TV error<=delta/4. Check BOTH exact original-class membership and the integer face equalities; map every failure to y and retain only actual on-face class populations. Every possible result then belongs to Gamma_F. Data processing and the ideal off-face mass bound give output-law TV<delta from pi0(.|Gamma_F), with paid EVERY-run witness/tilt/class-sampler/comparison/output costs. This is unconditional approximate distributional sampling with EXACT face support, not exact sampling or physical face-invariant kinetics.
